items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a band he was writing for and playing in also.

ctx.x: There’s just some things that are not answerable, apparently. You knew Bill Russo and others in high school, I just wanted to just touch on that a little bit. Did you and Russo play together in high school?
There was a band he was writing for and playing in also.
